The '''Pamorjal Freeman's League''' was a resistance group that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pamorjal]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the wood from [[garna tree]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of tree native to Pamorjal, became popular in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. This caused mega-corporations, such as [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]], begin to exploit the planet so that they could harvest the trees. The PFL was formed to oppose their actions and began attacking corporation assets on Pamorjal. [[Taj Vellion]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Pammorjal, was unwilling to do anything about them, but soon came under increasing pressure to act.

The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] traveled to Pamorjal in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and was being pursued by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents. To get them off his tail, he contacted the PFL and tricked them into believing that the alliance agents posed a threat to them. The PFL attacked the agents outside the [[Temples of Vormijj]], but eventually realized that Rystra had tricked them. As they had destroyed the ship that the alliance agents had been using, the PFL gave the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'' as a replacement.
